recap.paragraph: Tyler Robles kicked a 46-yard field goal in overtime to win it! Washington beat No. 8 Indiana 27-24 in Washington. Demond Williams Jr. had raced 65 yards for an early touchdown. Charlie Becker answered with a 74-yard touchdown catch for Indiana. Late in the game, Williams found Decker DeGraaf for the tying touchdown! Robles finished the comeback with his kick. It was Washington’s first win over a top-10 team in 2 years.
